options.text: Whether the IAM URI uses a KSA subject, namespace set, or cluster set selector

feedback.Reason: The selector type determines the workload set matched by the binding.

Details.mechanismOrProperty: principal selects one identity while principalSet can select namespaces, clusters, groups, or attributes.

Details.errorCorrection: Do not infer selector scope from the role name alone.

items.prompt: A team wants a production GKE workload identity to survive Pod rescheduling. Which identity should it bind to?
constraints: The external issuer, credential claims, federation boundary, target resource, Kubernetes identity, and token path stated in the scenario are fixed.
Choose one canonical Google Cloud workload-identity, federation, mapping, condition, or GKE identity decision.
Do not substitute DNS, billing, cache, or unrelated resource behavior for the stated identity contract.

options.text: The Kubernetes ServiceAccount rather than an individual Pod
The container image digest as an IAM principal

feedback.Reason: Pods are replaceable, while the KSA is the intended workload identity boundary.

Details.mechanismOrProperty: All Pods using the KSA can obtain the same federated identity subject.
Details.scenarioApplication: Bind target access to the KSA and use deployment replicas without changing IAM per Pod.
Details.errorCorrection: Do not grant access to ephemeral Pod identifiers when the workload identity should remain stable across rescheduling.
Details.boundaryOrTradeoff: The boundary is stable KSA workload identity versus ephemeral instance identity.
Details.transfer: If the scope, evidence, lifecycle, or failure boundary changes, reassess the trust-boundary and federation troubleshooting decision before transferring the answer.

wrongOptionExplanationsByOptionId.B: This choice crosses the stated workload-identity boundary because it would the ephemeral Pod IP.
wrongOptionExplanationsByOptionId.C: This choice crosses the stated workload-identity boundary because it would the node hostname only.
wrongOptionExplanationsByOptionId.D: This choice crosses the stated workload-identity boundary because it would the container image digest as an IAM principal.
